era: 约前 484 年生于小亚细亚西海岸的哈利卡纳苏斯——多里安希腊城市，处于波斯帝国统治圈与希腊世界的交界地带；家族属显贵阶层，因参与反对本地僭主吕格萨米斯的斗争一度流亡萨摩斯；青年时代广泛游历：黑海沿岸的锡西厄、埃及（自尼罗河口上溯至孟菲斯与底比斯）、两河流域、腓尼基、意大利南部——'到过比任何人都更多的地球表面'；约前 447 年移居雅典，与伯里克利时代的智者圈（普罗塔戈拉等）交往；前 444 年参与图里伊殖民地的建立并终老于此；毕生著作《历史》（Historiae）九卷，以希波战争为主线，卷一至卷五铺陈波斯帝国的扩张与各文明的民俗地理，卷六至卷九叙述战争本身；约前 425 年前后去世——后世称其为'历史之父'（西塞罗语），其著作是希腊散文叙事传统的第一批完整丰碑
era_en: Born about 484 BC at Halicarnassus on the south-west coast of Asia Minor — a Dorian Greek city on the seam between the Persian imperial sphere and the Greek world; of a distinguished family, exiled for a time to Samos for its part in the struggle against the local tyrant Lygdamis; in youth he travelled widely — Scythia on the Black Sea, Egypt from the delta up to Memphis and Thebes, Mesopotamia, Phoenicia, southern Italy — 'having seen more of the earth's surface than any man'; about 447 BC he moved to Athens and moved among the circles of the Sophists of the Periclean age; in 444 he took part in the founding of the colony of Thurii, where he died; his nine-book Histories, with the Persian Wars as their spine — books I to V laying out the growth of the Persian empire and the customs and geography of its peoples, books VI to IX the war itself; dead about 425 BC — 'the father of history' (Cicero's word), his work the first complete monument of the Greek prose narrative tradition
school: 史学奠基 / 询证与存疑 / 民俗志与比较文明 / 口述档案 / 叙事史之父
historical_significance: 历史学的立法者：《历史》九卷使'对过去的陈述'第一次成为以调查、证据与可核查性为标准的独立事业——'历史'（historia）一词即源于他的'调查'；他发明了至今仍构成史学基干的一整套零件：证据分层（亲证/传闻/存疑）、来源标注、多声部并置、跨文明比较、口述档案化、存疑保真；他把波斯人、埃及人、斯基泰人当作可平视的知识对象而非蛮族镜像——开创了相对主义的人类学眼光（'风俗是万物之王'）；他用可读的叙事搬运证据，使史学从诞生起就同时是科学的事业与文学的事业；西塞罗称'历史之父'，普鲁塔克攻击他'恶毒'——两千年里围绕他的争论本身证明他立下的标准仍是战场
historical_significance_en: The lawgiver of history: the nine books of the Histories made 'statements about the past' for the first time an independent enterprise governed by inquiry, evidence and checkability — the word historia, inquiry, is his; he invented the whole set of parts that still form the backbone of the discipline: graded evidence (autopsy, report, doubt), source-tagging, the juxtaposition of voices, comparison across civilisations, the archiving of oral tradition, the preserving of the doubtful; he treated Persians, Egyptians and Scythians as objects of knowledge seen eye to eye, not barbarian mirrors — founding the relativist anthropological gaze ('custom is king of all'); he carried evidence in readable narrative, so that from birth history was at once a scientific and a literary enterprise; Cicero named him father of history, Plutarch attacked his 'malice' — that the argument over him has run two millennia is itself proof that the standard he set is still the battlefield
unique_thinking: 希罗多德的思维内核是'调查的双轨'：一手用身体取得证据（走到、看到、量到、问到），一手对取得的一切公开标注置信度——记录的义务与裁决的节制同时到位；第二个内核是'多声部'：真相不在任何单一叙事里，而在波斯人说、埃及人说、希腊人说的并置空隙中——失败者的动机链与胜利者同样完整；第三个内核是'因果网'：拒绝把重大事件归给单一原因，体制、利益、个人、偶然分层入账，风暴与神谕也是历史的一部分；第四个内核是'风俗为王'：进入对方的理所当然内部去理解，再从外部比较——惊骇感是调查的起点而非结论；第五个内核是'存疑保真'：奇闻不删除、不背书，原文保存并标注——档案的完整光谱高于叙述的整洁
unique_thinking_en: Herodotus' cognitive core is the two rails of inquiry: with the body he gathers evidence — going, seeing, measuring, asking — and over all he gathers he publicly marks its credit; the duty to record and the restraint of judgment fall due together; the second core is the many voices: truth lives not in any single narrative but in the space between 'the Persians say' and 'the Egyptians say' — the vanquished' motive chains as complete as the victors'; the third is the web of causes: no great event referred to a single cause, institution, interest, person and chance filed by layer, storm and oracle part of history; the fourth, custom is king: enter the other's 'of course' from within to understand, then compare from outside — the sense of horror the beginning of inquiry, not its conclusion; the fifth, preserve the wonder: the marvellous neither deleted nor endorsed, kept verbatim with its doubt declared — the complete spectrum of the archive outranks the tidiness of the tale
civilization_zh: 公元前五世纪的地中海三文明交界带：波斯帝国的行省制与御道体系、希腊城邦世界的殖民网络与民主实验、埃及的祭司文明与尼罗河历法——三种文明在希波战争的熔炉里互相打量；口述传统（行吟诗人、德尔斐祭司、家族谱系）仍承担记忆主载体而文字书写正在扩张的过渡时代；智者运动把'人是万物的尺度'带进雅典的思想市场；哈利卡纳苏斯的多里安边缘身份让他天生处于'内外之间'——既非波斯臣民心态亦非雅典中心心态
civilization_en: The three-civilisation frontier zone of the fifth-century Mediterranean: the satrapies and royal roads of the Persian empire, the colonial network and democratic experiment of the Greek polis world, the priestly civilisation and Nile calendar of Egypt — three civilisations measuring one another in the furnace of the Persian Wars; a transitional age when oral tradition (rhapsodes, Delphic priests, family genealogies) still bore the memory while writing was expanding; the Sophists bringing 'man the measure' into the Athenian marketplace of ideas; his Dorian marginality at Halicarnassus left him natively 'between inside and outside' — neither the mind of a Persian subject nor that of an Athenian centrist
roles_zh: 史学家（西方'历史之父'、《历史》九卷作者）；民族志学者（埃及、斯基泰、波斯风俗的系统记录者）；地理探险者（'到过比任何人都更多的地球表面'）；比较文明学者（'风俗是万物之王'的相对主义立法者）；叙事艺术家（用悲剧结构与人物对话搬运证据的散文叙事开创者）
roles_en: Historian (the West's 'father of history', author of the nine books); ethnographer (the systematic recorder of Egyptian, Scythian and Persian custom); geographer-traveller ('having seen more of the earth's surface than any man'); comparativist (the relativist lawgiver of 'custom is king of all'); narrative artist (founder of prose storytelling that carries evidence in tragedy-structure and character-speech)

modes.domain_zh: 历史方法论/历史学的出生证——'历史'一词即希罗多德的'调查'（historia）：亲历、目击、询证，把对过去的陈述从神话叙事转为可核查的证据链；但同时公开标注'我说的是我听到的，但我不必然相信'——证据分层与存疑声明同场并用，记录而不裁决，开创了'呈现证据等级'的书写传统
modes.domain_en: Historical methodology / the birth certificate of history itself — 'history' is Herodotus' own word historia, inquiry: going, seeing, asking, converting statements about the past from mythic narrative into checkable chains of evidence; yet at the same time he openly tags 'I say what I have heard, but I am not bound to believe it' — grading of evidence and declaration of doubt deployed together, recording without adjudicating, founding the tradition of presenting the grade of one's evidence

modes.source_chapter: 希罗多德《历史》卷二（埃及）多处：'我把听到的写下来，但我并没有义务相信——这句话贯穿全书'
modes.key_quote_zh: 我把听到的写下来，但我并不必然相信——调查的义务是记录，不是裁决；证据要标出等级，怀疑要公开声明。
modes.key_quote_en: I write what I have heard, but I am not bound to believe it — the duty of inquiry is to record, not to adjudicate; grade the evidence, declare the doubt.
key_concepts: 调查即本义 historia as inquiry（'历史'一词的原义是调查——过去的知识必须以询问取得而非以传说继承）
historia as inquiry (the word 'history' means asking — knowledge of the past must be got by enquiry, not inherited as tale)
亲证优先 autopsy first（'自我看见'（autopsia）高于道听途说——亲眼所见、亲脚所至的证据最高）
autopsy first ('seeing for oneself' outranks hearsay — what the eye has seen and the foot has walked to stands highest)
存疑声明 the declaration of doubt（记录与相信分离——写下所闻并公开标注置信度，读者自断）
the declaration of doubt (recording and believing kept apart — write what was heard and publicly mark its credit, letting the reader judge)
传说与实证并置 legend and evidence side by side（神话版本与可核查版本同场呈现——不清洗也不采信，让对照本身工作）
legend and evidence side by side (the mythic version and the checkable version presented together — neither purged nor adopted, the contrast itself at work)
process_zh: 列证据清单：把一个问题的全部说法归档——谁说的、在哪说的、是否亲眼所见
标等级：目击 > 当地通说 > 远方传闻——每条材料打上可信度标签
写存疑声明：对无法核验的材料原文照录并公开标注'我不必然相信'——不删除也不背书
让读者裁决：结论处并置各版本与各自的证据等级——把判断权交给有证据在手的人
process_en: List the testimony: archive every version of a question — who said it, where, and whether they saw it themselves
Grade it: eyewitness > local consensus > far report — tag each item with its credit
Declare the doubt: quote unverifiable material verbatim and publicly mark 'I am not bound to believe it' — neither deleted nor endorsed
Let the reader judge: at the close set the versions side by side with their grades — hand the verdict to whoever holds the evidence
representative_cases_zh: 《历史》卷二的埃及考察：亲历孟菲斯与底比斯，测量金字塔、比对祭司档案，同时照录当地神谱传说并标注存疑——目击与传闻分层的原型
对'伊奥之风'成因的三种解释并置：他给出三种说法的来源（埃及祭司/希腊智者/自己的推测）且拒绝裁决——证据等级公开化的标本
对阿拉克西曼德式地理传闻的处理：凡未亲至之地标明'传闻如此'——地图上诚实留白的第一人
representative_cases_en: The Egyptian inquiry of Book II: he walked Memphis and Thebes, measured the pyramids, compared priestly archives — and yet recorded the local theogonies verbatim with his doubt declared — the prototype of stratified testimony
The three explanations of the flooding of the Nile set side by side: sources named (Egyptian priests, Greek sages, his own conjecture) and verdict refused — the specimen of published evidence-grading
His handling of far geography: lands he had not reached marked 'so it is reported' — the first honest blank on a map
modern_applications_zh: 尽职调查报告：把'经管理层确认/据团队转述/据外部传闻'三级来源标注在每段结论旁——证据等级公开，读者自断
研究综述写作：引用时区分一手实验、二手综述、三手科普——存疑声明写进正文而非脚注
产品决策备忘录：'我写下我听到的，但我并不必然相信'——把数据、访谈与坊间说法分档呈现，避免传说变决议
modern_applications_en: A due-diligence report: 'confirmed by management / relayed by the team / reported outside' tagged beside every conclusion — the grade of evidence public, the reader to judge
Writing a literature review: first-hand experiment, second-hand survey, third-hand popularisation distinguished at citation — the declaration of doubt in the body text, not the footnote
A product decision memo: 'I write what I heard but am not bound to believe it' — data, interviews and corridor talk presented in tiers, so rumour cannot become resolution

modes.domain_zh: 历史方法论/不设单一叙事声部——波斯人说、埃及人说、希腊人说在同一场域并置：每个文明的自我陈述与其对手的陈述同时入档，胜利者与失败者各执一词都得到记录；以声音的复数对抗叙事的垄断，读者在声部间自行定位真相
modes.domain_en: Historical methodology / no single narrative voice is seated — the Persians say, the Egyptians say, the Greeks say, all entered in the same field: each people's account of itself and of its enemy recorded alike, victor and vanquished each holding their word; the plural of voices against the monopoly of narrative, the reader locating truth among the parts

modes.source_chapter: 《历史》对希波战争的写法：大流士、薛西斯、阿尔泰米西娅等波斯人物的完整发言与动机——失败一方的内在逻辑得到平视
modes.key_quote_zh: 波斯人有波斯人的说法，埃及人有埃及人的说法——我把它们并排放着；真相不在某个声部里，而在声部之间的空隙里。
modes.key_quote_en: The Persians have their word and the Egyptians theirs — I set them side by side; truth lives not in any one voice but in the space between them.
key_concepts: 失败者入档 the vanquished enter the record（薛西斯的骄傲与犹疑、波斯的战略理性照实呈现——历史不是胜利者的独白）
the vanquished enter the record (Xerxes' pride and hesitation, the strategic reason of Persia set down as they were — history is no victor's monologue)
动机内视角 the inside of motive（为敌方人物写出可理解的动机链——对手不是妖魔而是可解释的行动者）
the inside of motive (an intelligible chain of motive written for the enemy — the adversary not a demon but an explicable actor)
并置不对辩 juxtaposition without adjudication（各声部原文照录而不当场裁判——裁判权留给读者与时间）
juxtaposition without adjudication (each voice recorded as spoken, no verdict on the spot — judgment left to the reader and to time)
声部即证据 voices as evidence（一个文明如何讲述自己与敌人，本身就是史料——叙事方式与叙事内容同值）
voices as evidence (how a civilisation tells itself and its enemy is itself a source — manner of telling equal in worth to matter told)
process_zh: 列声部清单：一个冲突中每个相关方的自我版本各归其档——包括最弱势方的版本
平视改写：为每个声部写出'从他们看来为何合理'——动机链完整到可以替对方辩护
并置呈现：各版本按同一问题对齐排版——矛盾点显性标出而不裁决
标注局限：声明哪些声部缺席（无文字者、被灭者）——档案的沉默也是记录
process_en: Inventory the voices: every party's account of itself filed separately — the weakest party's version included
Rewrite eye-to-eye: for each voice write 'why this seemed reasonable from within' — the motive chain complete enough to argue the other side
Set them in parallel: versions aligned on the same question, contradictions marked openly and left unjudged
Mark the silence: declare which voices are absent (the unwritten, the destroyed) — the silence of the archive is itself a record
representative_cases_zh: 薛西斯在《历史》卷七的完整肖像：夜哭与检阅百万大军同场并置——入侵者的雄心、恐惧与自欺得到平等呈现，波斯的决策逻辑可完整复盘
对'谁先挑衅'的波斯版本与腓尼基版本照录：希波开战缘由给出多重谱系（波斯说/腓尼基说/希腊沉默）——开战责任悬而不决
斯巴达人德玛拉托斯对薛西斯的进言照录：被征服者对征服者的当面诤言完整存档——失败方声音的保全样本
representative_cases_en: The full portrait of Xerxes in Book VII: the night weeping set beside the review of the million-man host — the invader's ambition, fear and self-deception rendered eye to eye, Persia's decision logic wholly reconstructible

The Persian and Phoenician versions of 'who began it' recorded as given: multiple genealogies of the war's cause (the Persian tale, the Phoenician tale, the Greek silence) — the blame for the war left suspended
Demaratus the Spartan's frank speech to Xerxes entered whole: the conquered man's plain words to the conqueror archived in full — the specimen of the vanquished voice preserved
modern_applications_zh: 竞争分析报告：不只写我方视角的'对手黑历史'，而是为竞品写出'从他们看为何合理'的完整动机链——并置而非辩论
组织冲突复盘：裁员、合并、路线之争，每个当事方版本都入档——一年后回看，多声部档案远比当时裁决接近真相
国际新闻写作：给冲突双方各自的原话版面而非转述拼贴——缺席声部显性标注
modern_applications_en: A competitive analysis: not our side's dossier of the rival's sins but the rival's own motive chain written complete enough to defend — set alongside, not argued against
An organisational post-mortem: the layoff, the merger, the road not taken, each party's account filed — a year later the many-voiced archive reads truer than the verdict of the day
Conflict journalism: each side given its own quoted column rather than a collage of paraphrase — absent voices marked as absent
representative_figures: 希罗多德（核心）
修昔底德（对照：以'史家裁决'取代多声部——科林斯与雅典在斯巴达同盟会议上的演说仍并置，但叙述者权威更强）
普鲁塔克（后继：平行传记法——两种文明并置传统的延伸）

modes.domain_zh: 历史方法论/拒绝为重大事件找单一原因——希波战争的成因被拆成经济（资源与贸易）、政治（波斯帝国的扩张逻辑）、个人（僭主的复仇与投机）、偶然（风暴、神谕、误会）多层因果网：伟大冲突不生于单点，而生于无数小因果的汇流；叙事的职责是让网可见
modes.domain_en: Historical methodology / refusal of the single cause for great events — the causes of the Persian Wars unpacked into a web: economic (resources and trade), political (the expansion logic of empire), personal (the revenge and speculation of tyrants), contingent (storms, oracles, misreadings); great conflicts are born not at a point but at the confluence of countless small causes; the narrator's duty is to make the web visible
modes.definition_zh: 历史方法论/拒绝为重大事件找单一原因——希波战争的成因被拆成经济（资源与贸易）、政治（波斯帝国的扩张逻辑）、个人（僭主的复仇与投机）、偶然（风暴、神谕、误会）多层因果网：伟大冲突不生于单点，而生于无数小因果的汇流；叙事的职责是让网可见
modes.definition_en: Historical methodology / refusal of the single cause for great events — the causes of the Persian Wars unpacked into a web: economic (resources and trade), political (the expansion logic of empire), personal (the revenge and speculation of tyrants), contingent (storms, oracles, misreadings); great conflicts are born not at a point but at the confluence of countless small causes; the narrator's duty is to make the web visible
modes.source_chapter: 《历史》开篇即纠正'抢女人引发的战争'的传说因果：先审希罗多德自己的知识边界（'谁最早冒犯谁，我不去说'），再逐层铺开波斯扩张的体制性因果
modes.key_quote_zh: 谁先冒犯谁，我不去查——但帝国的逻辑、僭主的私怨、一次风暴和一个误译，共同把希腊推到了温泉关。
modes.key_quote_en: Who first offended whom I shall not pursue — but the logic of empire, a tyrant's grudge, one storm and one mistranslation together brought Greece to Thermopylae.
key_concepts: 反单因立场 anti-single-cause（伟大事件必被简化为英雄或妖魔——追问法的第一步是拒绝这个简化）
anti-single-cause (great events will be flattened into hero or demon — the first act of the method is to refuse the flattening)
层次拆分 layered decomposition（体制因果/利益因果/个人因果/偶然因果分层归档——每层有自己的时间尺度）
layered decomposition (institutional, interest, personal, contingent causes filed by layer — each with its own timescale)
小因汇流 confluence of small causes（战争不是爆发的而是汇成的——追踪许多可单独忽略的因果如何叠加过阈值）
confluence of small causes (wars are not detonated but gathered — track how individually negligible causes stack past threshold)
偶然入账 chance on the books（风暴与神谕进入因果网——偶然不是叙事的杂质而是历史的一部分）
chance on the books (storms and oracles enter the web — contingency not an impurity of narrative but part of history)
process_zh: 拒绝第一因：把'因为X所以Y'的快答悬置——先列出Y的全部前提条件
分层归档：把前提按体制/利益/个人/偶然分四层——每层追问'这层自身由什么造成'
追踪汇流：画出各层因果的交汇点——哪几条小因果在同一时段叠加
标注反事实：写下'若抽掉这条因果，事件还成立吗'——网的每条线都做拆除检验
process_en: Suspend the quick answer: set aside 'because X therefore Y' — first list every precondition of Y
File by layer: sort the preconditions into institutional, interest, personal, contingent — then ask of each layer what made it
Trace the confluence: draw where the layers meet — which small causes stacked in the same season
Test the counterfactual: for each strand write 'does the event still stand if this strand is cut' — every line of the web undergoes removal
representative_cases_zh: 希波战争成因的完整铺陈：吕底亚灭亡、波斯行省制的扩张惯性、雅典与波斯外交误判、伊奥尼亚叛乱的雅典介入、大流士的个人复仇——单一'波斯入侵'被拆成五层因果网
温泉关之战的失败归因：不归给列奥尼达一人之勇或叛徒一人之罪——小路泄露、同盟迟疑、神谕压力、地形限制多层并列
居鲁士崛起的因果书写：波斯部落政治、米底宫廷内乱、个人的军事才能与运气同场入账——开国之君不做单点英雄
representative_cases_en: The full laying-out of the Persian Wars' causes: the fall of Lydia, the expansion inertia of the satrapy system, Athenian-Persian diplomatic misreading, Athenian meddling in the Ionian revolt, Darius' private revenge — a single 'Persian invasion' unpacked into five layers of web
The attribution of Thermopylae: not to Leonidas' valour alone nor one traitor's guilt — the leaked path, the allies' hesitation, the oracle's pressure, the terrain, laid out in layers
The causality of Cyrus' rise: tribal politics of Persia, disorder in the Median court, personal gift for war and luck entered together — the founder no single-point hero
modern_applications_zh: 事故根因分析：拒绝'操作员失误'的单一结论——把体制排班、界面设计、培训缺口、当日天气分层归档，做出因果网图
公司失败复盘：'创始人犯错'之上追问体制层（治理结构）、利益层（投资人压力）、偶然层（周期）——每层做反事实拆除检验
产品增长归因：拒绝单一'爆点'叙事——渠道、时机、竞品动作、用户习惯迁移画出汇流图
modern_applications_en: A root-cause analysis: refuse the single verdict 'operator error' — roster design, interface, training gaps and that day's weather filed by layer into a web diagram

A company-failure post-mortem: above 'the founder erred' ask the institutional layer (governance), the interest layer (investor pressure), the contingent layer (the cycle) — each layer counterfactually cut
Growth attribution: refuse the single 'explosive moment' — channels, timing, rival moves and the migration of user habit drawn as a confluence chart
representative_figures: 希罗多德（核心）
修昔底德（后继：把因果网收紧到'人性不变'的深层结构——多因传统的强化与收窄）
色诺芬（同代：以个人经验补因果链的实操层——《长征记》的行军因果记录）

modes.domain_zh: 研究方法论/用双脚为知识定界——亲自巡历尼罗河两岸、黑海沿岸、两河流域，凡亲至之地用测量（金字塔高度、河道距离）、比对（祭司档案与神庙铭刻）取得一手数据；凡未至之地明确标注边界——知识的地图上，'我去过'与'我听说'用两种颜色画出
modes.domain_en: Research methodology / bounding knowledge by the feet — personally touring the Nile's banks, the Black Sea coast, the rivers of Mesopotamia; where he went, first-hand data by measurement (the height of pyramids, the distances of channels) and comparison (priestly archives against temple inscriptions); where he did not go, the boundary openly drawn — on the map of knowledge 'I have been' and 'I have heard' drawn in two colours
modes.definition_zh: 研究方法论/用双脚为知识定界——亲自巡历尼罗河两岸、黑海沿岸、两河流域，凡亲至之地用测量（金字塔高度、河道距离）、比对（祭司档案与神庙铭刻）取得一手数据；凡未至之地明确标注边界——知识的地图上，'我去过'与'我听说'用两种颜色画出
modes.definition_en: Research methodology / bounding knowledge by the feet — personally touring the Nile's banks, the Black Sea coast, the rivers of Mesopotamia; where he went, first-hand data by measurement (the height of pyramids, the distances of channels) and comparison (priestly archives against temple inscriptions); where he did not go, the boundary openly drawn — on the map of knowledge 'I have been' and 'I have heard' drawn in two colours
modes.source_chapter: 《历史》卷二：对埃及的实地测量与访谈清单——金字塔逐座量度、木乃伊工艺亲见、祭司世系抄录；与传闻部分形成显式对照
modes.key_quote_zh: 走到的地方，用尺子说话；没走到的地方，说'传闻如此'——知识的边界要画在明处。
modes.key_quote_en: Where I walked, the ruler speaks; where I did not, 'so it is reported' — the boundary of knowledge drawn in the open.
key_concepts: 双腿知识学 the knowledge of the legs（坐拥书斋 vs 巡历大地——一手数据的取得以身体到场为前提）
the knowledge of the legs (the study versus the circuit — first-hand data presupposes the body on site)
测量与访谈并举 measurement and interview together（尺子量地貌、嘴问活档案——物理数据与口述证词互相校验）
measurement and interview together (the ruler for the terrain, the mouth for the living archive — physical data and oral testimony cross-checking)
边界诚实 honesty at the frontier（未至之地不伪装亲证——'我听说'是知识的合法形态，只要标明）
honesty at the frontier (places unreached not disguised as visited — 'I have heard' is a lawful form of knowledge, once marked)
地图留白 the blank on the map（不猜远处地形——留白本身就是对未来调查的邀请函）
the blank on the map (the far terrain not guessed — the blank itself an invitation to future inquiry)
process_zh: 画行程线：把问题涉及的全部地点标出——区分'已亲至/可达未至/不可达'三级
现场取数：每至一地同时采集两类数据——可测量的物理证据与在地的口述档案
比对校验：将口述与实物/铭刻/档案交叉核对——冲突处记录而不抹平
标注边界：对未至之地写明信息来源与可信度——地图上的留白公开声明
process_en: Draw the route: mark every place the question touches — three grades of reached, reachable-not-visited, unreachable
Take data on site: at each place gather both kinds — measurable physical evidence and local oral archives
Cross-check: set the oral against artefact, inscription and archive — conflicts recorded, not smoothed
Mark the frontier: for unreached places state the source and its credit — the blank declared in the open
representative_cases_zh: 埃及考察清单的复原：孟菲斯、底比斯、孟东斯逐城记录测量值与祭司访谈——两千多年后考古学验证其数据大体可靠
黑海沿岸的锡西厄调查：对游牧民族的访谈网与沿途物产记录——民族志田野的最早完整样本
对'欧洲尽头'与'亚洲尽头'的处理：未至之地一律标注传闻来源——地图留白对照托勒密之前的想象地理
representative_cases_en: The reconstruction of the Egyptian itinerary: Memphis, Thebes, Marea, each city's measurements and priestly interviews recorded — validated in bulk by archaeology two millennia on
The Scythian inquiry of the Black Sea coast: an interview web over the nomads with a record of goods along the way — the earliest complete specimen of ethnographic fieldwork
His handling of 'the ends of Europe and Asia': unvisited lands always tagged with the source of report — honest blanks against the imagined geography before Ptolemy
modern_applications_zh: 用户研究：'自己去现场'与'读客服转述'分开建档——到访过的门店用实测数据，未到访的标注访谈层级
尽调与审计：清单上区分'实地盘点/视频核验/文件审阅'三级证据——留白处显性声明
技术方案调研：亲手跑过的 demo 与读过的评测文档分色标注——'我跑过'与'我听说'两种颜色
modern_applications_en: User research: 'went on site' and 'read support transcripts' filed apart — measured data for visited stores, interview grades declared for the rest
Audit and diligence: the checklist distinguishes physical count, video verification, document review — blanks declared openly
Technical due diligence: demos you have run yourself and reviews you have only read marked in two colours — 'I ran it' and 'I heard of it'
representative_figures: 希罗多德（核心）
斯特拉波（后继：地理学巡证传统的体系化——测量取代叙事）
马苏迪/伊本·白图泰（同构：伊斯兰世界的旅行考察传统——巡证方法的跨文明再现）

modes.domain_zh: 文明比较方法论/《历史》卷三明确立论：'风俗是万物之王'（nomos panton basileus）——每个文明用自己的风俗判断一切，把对方的风俗当怪异是普遍错误；方法上要求：进入一个文明的评价系统内部去理解其行为，再从外部比较——相对性不是立场而是方法工具
modes.domain_en: Civilisational comparison methodology / the explicit thesis of Book III: 'custom is king of all' (nomos panton basileus) — every people judges all things by its own custom, and to find another's customs strange is the universal error; methodologically: enter a civilisation's evaluative system to understand its conduct, then compare from outside — relativity not a stance but a working tool
modes.definition_zh: 文明比较方法论/《历史》卷三明确立论：'风俗是万物之王'（nomos panton basileus）——每个文明用自己的风俗判断一切，把对方的风俗当怪异是普遍错误；方法上要求：进入一个文明的评价系统内部去理解其行为，再从外部比较——相对性不是立场而是方法工具
modes.definition_en: Civilisational comparison methodology / the explicit thesis of Book III: 'custom is king of all' (nomos panton basileus) — every people judges all things by its own custom, and to find another's customs strange is the universal error; methodologically: enter a civilisation's evaluative system to understand its conduct, then compare from outside — relativity not a stance but a working tool
modes.source_chapter: 《历史》卷三·38：大流士问希腊人能否吃父尸、问卡拉提亚人能否焚父尸——双方皆拒，各自惊骇对方；希罗多德断言：'风俗是万物之王'
modes.key_quote_zh: 大流士的提问让双方都惊骇——风俗是万物之王；理解一个文明，先住进它的'理所当然'里。
modes.key_quote_en: Darius' question horrified both — custom is king of all; to understand a people, first dwell inside its 'of course'.
key_concepts: 风俗为王 nomos as king（评价系统是文化地方的产物——没有风俗之外的'中立裁判席'）
nomos as king (the standard of judgment is a local product — no neutral bench outside custom)
双向惊骇 the double horror（让两个文明各自惊骇对方——惊骇的对称性暴露的是评价系统而非本性）
the double horror (each civilisation horrified at the other — the symmetry of horror exposes the evaluative systems, not the natures)
内进外比 enter within, compare without（先按对方逻辑复原其行为的合理性，再与己方系统比较——两步不可并作一步）
enter within, compare without (first restore the reasonableness of the other's conduct by its own logic, then compare with one's own — two steps never one)
反投射 anti-projection（把'我们觉得怪'转写为'他们为何觉得必然'——怪异感是调查的起点而非结论）
anti-projection (rewrite 'we find it strange' as 'why do they find it necessary' — the sense of strangeness is the start of inquiry, not its conclusion)
process_zh: 捕捉惊骇：记录己方对某风俗的本能不适——这份不适是数据不是结论
内部复原：用对方的价值前提重建该行为的逻辑——写到'在他们的前提下属理性选择'为止
对称检验：找一个己方风俗，从对方视角重建其'惊骇理由'——检验对称性
外部比较：在两个系统都复原后做结构比较——比功能不比道德
process_en: Capture the horror: record one's own instinctive discomfort at a custom — the discomfort is data, not verdict
Restore from within: rebuild the conduct's logic from the other's premises — until 'a rational choice given their premises' can be written
Test the symmetry: take one of our own customs and rebuild from their side why it would horrify — check the symmetry
Compare without: once both systems are restored, compare structure — compare function, not morality
representative_cases_zh: 大流士的双问实验（卷三·38）：希腊人拒食父尸、印度人拒焚父尸——希罗多德以居鲁士式的提问设计让'正常'本身现形
对埃及女性站立小便/男性坐着的记录：只记功能与宗教理由，不用希腊标准贬斥——风俗记录去道德化的最早样本
对波斯人名与希腊人名的命名系统、对斯基泰葬俗的处理：先内部复原再并置——比较人类学的方法原型
representative_cases_en: Darius' two-question experiment (III.38): Greeks refusing to eat their fathers, the Indians refusing to burn them — an enquiry so framed that 'the normal' itself stands revealed
His record of Egyptian women standing to make water, men sitting: function and religious reason given, no Greek deprecation — the earliest sample of de-moralised custom recording
His handling of Persian naming systems and Scythian burial: restored from within before setting side by side — the prototype of comparative anthropology
modern_applications_zh: 跨国团队管理：'他们为什么这么开会'先内部复原（层级/面子/决策传统）再比较——惊骇感转为调查提纲
出海产品本地化：把'用户行为好奇怪'改写为'在他们的生活前提下这解决什么问题'——功能对齐而非习惯评判
代码评审与文化差异：直陈式与含蓄式反馈系统各自内部复原——先理解对方的'理所当然'再定协作规范
modern_applications_en: Managing a multinational team: 'why do they run meetings this way' restored from within (hierarchy, face, decision tradition) before comparing — the horror turned into a questionnaire
Product localisation: rewrite 'the users behave so oddly' as 'given how they live, what problem does this solve' — align on function, not on habit
Code review across cultures: direct and indirect feedback systems each restored from within — understand the other's 'of course' before setting norms
representative_figures: 希罗多德（核心）
色诺芬尼（思想源流：'埃塞俄比亚人把神画成黑的'——相对论的哲学先声）
孟德斯鸠（后继：法的精神与风俗——相对性进入政治哲学）

modes.domain_zh: 史料学方法论/在文字档案稀薄的时代把口述当作正档案：德尔斐祭司的系谱、斯巴达长者的记忆、行吟诗人的传唱、商队路线上的故事——逐一记录来源（谁说的、在哪说的）使口述可追溯可校验；口述不是文学的替代品而是'活人的档案库'
modes.domain_en: Source-criticism methodology / in an age of thin written records, oral tradition taken as archive proper: the genealogies of Delphic priests, the memory of Spartan elders, the chant of rhapsodes, tales along caravan routes — each recorded with its source (who said it, where) so that the oral is traceable and checkable; oral tradition not a substitute for literature but 'the archive of the living'
modes.definition_zh: 史料学方法论/在文字档案稀薄的时代把口述当作正档案：德尔斐祭司的系谱、斯巴达长者的记忆、行吟诗人的传唱、商队路线上的故事——逐一记录来源（谁说的、在哪说的）使口述可追溯可校验；口述不是文学的替代品而是'活人的档案库'
modes.definition_en: Source-criticism methodology / in an age of thin written records, oral tradition taken as archive proper: the genealogies of Delphic priests, the memory of Spartan elders, the chant of rhapsodes, tales along caravan routes — each recorded with its source (who said it, where) so that the oral is traceable and checkable; oral tradition not a substitute for literature but 'the archive of the living'
modes.source_chapter: 《历史》通篇的来源标注：'拉栖代梦人是这样说的''埃及祭司如此告诉我''德尔斐人声称'——口述材料的系统溯源
modes.key_quote_zh: 祭司的口、老人的记忆、诗人的歌，都是档案——只要记下是谁说的、在哪里说的。
modes.key_quote_en: The priest's mouth, the old man's memory, the poet's chant — all archive, so long as you set down who said it and where.
key_concepts: 口述即档案 oral as archive（记忆的传承链就是文献的传承链——处理方法相同：溯源、比对、定级）
oral as archive (the chain of memory a chain of documents — treated alike: sourced, compared, graded)
溯源标注 source-tagging（每条口述记下讲述人与场合——口述从'轶事'升格为'可核查材料'）
source-tagging (each oral item logged with teller and occasion — anecdote upgraded to checkable material)
活档案库 the archive of the living（档案不止在石碑与神庙——社区的长者是会走路的档案馆）
the archive of the living (the archive not only in stone and temple — a community's elders are walking archives)
记忆与文字互校 memory against writing（口述与铭刻、神庙档案互证——两种介质的偏差本身就是发现）
memory against writing (oral checked against inscription and temple archive — the divergence of the two media is itself a finding)
process_zh: 建讲述人清单：一个问题找到全部相关讲述群体——祭司/长者/行会/旅人分类建档
逐条溯源：每条口述记录讲述人、场合、转手次数——给出可信度初评
双介质校验：把口述与碑刻、档案、实物对碰——一致与冲突同样入档
版本归档：同一故事的不同讲述版本都保存——口述的'异文'是流变证据
process_en: Build the teller list: find every group that tells — priests, elders, guilds, travellers, filed by class
Source every item: each oral record logs teller, occasion, transfers — a first credit estimate
Check across media: set the oral against inscription, archive, artefact — agreement and conflict both entered
Archive the variants: different tellings of one tale all kept — the oral 'variant reading' is evidence of drift
representative_cases_zh: 对埃及祭司的访谈链：希罗多德记录孟菲斯祭司报出的三百四十一代人王表——口述世系成为可与铭刻互校的编年材料
斯巴达与雅典的口传政制：来库古制度全凭长者口传，他照录并注明无文字可查——口传制度的忠实存档
阿尔戈斯女祭司口述神庙史与神庙铭刻的比对——口述与实物档案互证的操作实例
representative_cases_en: The interview chain with Egyptian priests: the lineage of 341 generations recited at Memphis — oral genealogy as chronicle material cross-checkable against inscriptions
The orally transmitted constitution of Sparta: the laws of Lycurgus kept by memory alone, recorded with the note that no writing exists — a faithful archive of an oral constitution
The oracle history told by the priestess of Argos checked against temple inscription — a working instance of oral versus material archive
modern_applications_zh: 口述史项目：家族企业史访谈——每位讲述人标注年代与转手层级，与账本、老照片互校
社区知识管理：老员工的操作经验当成'活档案'系统采集——记录人、场景、版本，与新员工培训文档互证
事故调查：当事人回忆与日志、监控对碰——记忆与文字的偏差点单独列出
modern_applications_en: An oral-history project: the family firm's past — each teller dated and tiered by transfer, checked against ledgers and old photographs
Community knowledge management: veterans' operating know-how gathered as a living archive — teller, scene and version recorded, cross-checked with training docs
Incident investigation: recollection set against logs and footage — the divergence points of memory and writing listed separately

modes.domain_zh: 史料学方法论/单条材料不定案——把神谕、铭刻、口述、实物对碰，只在多源一致处下判断；冲突处不抹平而是公开记录冲突本身；把'孤证不立'从直觉变成程序：任何重要结论至少要两条独立材料支撑
modes.domain_en: Source-criticism methodology / no verdict on a single item — oracle, inscription, oral tale and physical remains set against one another, judgment passed only where independent sources agree; at conflict, the conflict itself recorded openly, not smoothed away; 'no verdict on a lone source' turned from instinct into procedure: any important conclusion needs two independent witnesses at least

modes.source_chapter: 《历史》对神谕的处理：德尔斐神谕既被记录为史料又被交叉检验（如克罗伊索斯再三求谕以验证）——信任以验证为前提
modes.key_quote_zh: 一条材料不足以定案——神谕要问第二遍，传说要问第二个部族；一致之处才可落笔，冲突之处如实写下冲突。
modes.key_quote_en: One witness does not close a case — ask the oracle a second time, ask the tale a second people; write only where they agree, and where they conflict, write the conflict.
key_concepts: 孤证不立 no verdict on a lone source（重要结论至少两条独立材料——独立性比数量更重要）
no verdict on a lone source (an important conclusion needs two independent witnesses — independence matters more than number)
验证性求谕 the confirming oracle（克罗伊索斯测试德尔斐——连神谕也要先验证再使用）
the confirming oracle (Croesus testing Delphi — even an oracle is verified before use)
冲突入档 the conflict on file（两个来源矛盾时不选边——矛盾本身作为高价值记录）
the conflict on file (when two sources clash, no side taken — the contradiction itself kept as high-value record)
介质多样性 medium diversity（口述/铭刻/实物/仪式四种介质交叉——同介质来源的'一致'不算数）
medium diversity (oral, inscription, artefact, rite crossing — agreement within one medium does not count)
process_zh: 列材料矩阵：一个结论涉及的全部材料按介质与来源独立度排成矩阵
找独立第二条：为关键结论寻找不同介质、不同立场的第二来源
标记一致区与冲突区：一致处可下暂定判断，冲突处原文并置
复核关键证据：对决定性材料做'克罗伊索斯检验'——验证来源本身是否可靠
process_en: Matrix the material: every source bearing on a conclusion arranged by medium and independence
Find the second witness: for each key conclusion a second source of different medium and different interest
Mark agreement and conflict: tentative judgment where they agree; verbatim juxtaposition where they clash
Re-verify the decisive item: run the 'Croesus test' on the pivotal source — is the source itself trustworthy
representative_cases_zh: 克罗伊索斯对德尔斐的三重验证：先派使者测试诸神谕所再正式求谕——'连神谕也要验证'的方法论自觉
对帕罗斯岛铭刻与雅典传说的交叉：阿里斯托底库斯案的铭刻证据与口传冲突处并存——材料矩阵的早期实践
对斯基泰王族葬仪的多重来源：当地口述、目击仪式、实物 mound 并置——孤证不立的完整示范
representative_cases_en: Croesus' threefold test of Delphi: envoys sent to try the oracles before the formal question — the methodological awareness that even an oracle must be verified
The Parian inscription against the Athenian tale: the Aristotle case where inscription and oral tradition conflict, both kept — an early exercise of the material matrix
The multiple sources on Scythian royal burial: local oral, witnessed rite and the burial mound set together — the full demonstration of no-verdict-on-a-lone-source
modern_applications_zh: 重大结论的证据矩阵：任何上会数字至少两个独立系统（财务系统+业务系统）支撑——孤证数据标黄待验
尽调交叉验证：创始人口述与工商档案、银行流水、客户访谈交叉——冲突点不做仲裁而是列明
新闻事实核查：关键引语要求两种独立渠道——'单一匿名信源'显著降级处理
modern_applications_en: An evidence matrix for any major conclusion: no figure reaches the board without two independent systems (finance plus operations) — lone-source data flagged for verification
Cross-checked diligence: the founder's account against registries, bank flows, customer interviews — conflicts listed, not arbitrated
Fact-checking in journalism: a key quotation needs two independent channels — the single anonymous source downgraded in print

modes.domain_zh: 文明比较方法论/把单一事件放进跨文明的坐标系：埃及的历法对照希腊的、波斯的行省对照希腊的城邦、斯基泰的战争方式对照农耕的战争方式——在文明尺度上,特殊性只有通过比较才成为可陈述的知识；比较单位不是人物与事件而是结构与风俗
modes.domain_en: Civilisational comparison methodology / the single event set within a cross-civilisational coordinate frame: the Egyptian calendar against the Greek, the Persian satrapy against the Greek polis, Scythian war-making against the settled kind — at the scale of civilisations, particularity becomes statable knowledge only through comparison; the unit of comparison not the person or event but the structure and the custom
modes.definition_zh: 文明比较方法论/把单一事件放进跨文明的坐标系：埃及的历法对照希腊的、波斯的行省对照希腊的城邦、斯基泰的战争方式对照农耕的战争方式——在文明尺度上,特殊性只有通过比较才成为可陈述的知识；比较单位不是人物与事件而是结构与风俗
modes.definition_en: Civilisational comparison methodology / the single event set within a cross-civilisational coordinate frame: the Egyptian calendar against the Greek, the Persian satrapy against the Greek polis, Scythian war-making against the settled kind — at the scale of civilisations, particularity becomes statable knowledge only through comparison; the unit of comparison not the person or event but the structure and the custom
modes.source_chapter: 《历史》对埃及文明的总评：'埃及是尼罗河的赠礼'——以河流-文明的结构关系取代传奇化的文明叙事
modes.key_quote_zh: 不比较国王与国王，而比较结构与结构——历法与历法、行省与城邦；特殊性只有放在坐标系里才成其为知识。
modes.key_quote_en: Compare not king with king but structure with structure — calendar with calendar, satrapy with polis; particularity becomes knowledge only inside a coordinate frame.
key_concepts: 结构比较单位 structure as the unit（比制度、比历法、比战争方式——结构与风俗才是可比的通约单位）
structure as the unit (institutions, calendars, ways of war compared — structure and custom the commensurable units)
地理-文明函数 geography-civilisation function（'埃及是尼罗河的赠礼'——把文明特征还原为地理与生存方式的结构关系）
geography-civilisation function ('Egypt the gift of the Nile' — civilisational traits reduced to the structural relation of land and livelihood)
对照显奇 the strange made visible by contrast（异文明是镜子——本文明的'理所当然'只在对照中显形）
the strange made visible by contrast (the other civilisation a mirror — one's own 'of course' visible only against it)
通约谨慎 care in commensuration（比较前先确认单位可通约——历法与历法可比，英雄与英雄未必可比）
care in commensuration (confirm the units before comparing — calendar with calendar yes, hero with hero not necessarily)
process_zh: 选通约单位：把问题从'人物/事件'层面移到'结构/风俗'层面——确定可比的对象
设坐标系：为每个文明在结构轴上定位——历法、政制、军事、信仰各轴分别定位
写对照表：结构对结构列表呈现——差异与雷同同等标注
追地理根：对每个结构差异追问'地理与生存方式如何造成它'——差异溯源到自然条件
process_en: Choose the commensurable unit: lift the question from person and event to structure and custom — fix what is comparable
Set the frame: locate each civilisation on the structural axes — calendar, polity, war, belief, each axis separately
Write the contrast table: structure against structure, differences and likenesses marked alike
Trace to the ground: for each structural difference ask how geography and livelihood made it — difference traced to nature
representative_cases_zh: '埃及是尼罗河的赠礼'的总纲：泛滥周期→农耕历法→祭司权力→测量学——一条河解释一整套文明结构
波斯行省制与希腊城邦制的对照：税制、兵制、忠诚结构逐项比较——两种国家形态的结构差异表
斯基泰游牧战争方式与定居民族战争方式的对照：机动、坚壁、后勤的体系差异——战争风格被还原为生存方式
representative_cases_en: The master thesis 'Egypt the gift of the Nile': flood cycle, farming calendar, priestly power, the art of measuring — one river explaining a whole structure of civilisation
The satrapy against the polis: taxation, conscription, structures of loyalty compared item by item — a structural contrast table of two state forms
Scythian nomad war against the settled kind: mobility, scorched earth, logistics — a way of war reduced to a way of life
modern_applications_zh: 商业模式比较：不比创始人与创始人，而比收入结构、决策结构、激励结构——结构对照表替代人物叙事
跨市场进入策略：把目标市场放在'渠道/信用/物流/监管'各轴上与本土市场定位——差异溯源到基础设施与生存方式
技术选型对比：不比框架与框架的粉丝口碑，而比部署结构、团队技能匹配、演化成本——通约单位先于结论
modern_applications_en: Comparing business models: not founder against founder but revenue structure, decision structure, incentive structure — a contrast table in place of the founder tale
Market-entry strategy: the target market located on the axes of channel, credit, logistics, regulation against the home market — differences traced to infrastructure and ways of life
Technology selection: not the fan-lore of framework against framework but deployment structure, team-skill fit, cost of evolution — the commensurable unit before the verdict
representative_figures: 希罗多德（核心）
孟德斯鸠（后继：地理-政体比较的体系化——《论法的精神》的方法直系）
韦伯（远裔：跨文明制度比较——比较单位彻底结构化）

modes.domain_zh: 写作方法论/历史知识的载体是可读的叙事而非干瘪的档案——对话、场景、动机与悬念都是史书的合法器官：克罗伊索斯的开场悲剧、薛西斯夜哭的场景、阿尔泰米西娅的谏言对话；但每个叙事装置都背着证据功能（人物发言承载其政治立场，场景承载其结构因果）——文学性与证据性同体
modes.domain_en: Writing methodology / the vehicle of historical knowledge is readable narrative, not desiccated archive — dialogue, scene, motive and suspense are lawful organs of the history: the opening tragedy of Croesus, the scene of Xerxes weeping at night, the debate speeches of Artemisia; yet every narrative device carries evidential freight (a person's speech carries their political position, a scene carries structural causation) — the literary and the evidential in one body
modes.definition_zh: 写作方法论/历史知识的载体是可读的叙事而非干瘪的档案——对话、场景、动机与悬念都是史书的合法器官：克罗伊索斯的开场悲剧、薛西斯夜哭的场景、阿尔泰米西娅的谏言对话；但每个叙事装置都背着证据功能（人物发言承载其政治立场，场景承载其结构因果）——文学性与证据性同体
modes.definition_en: Writing methodology / the vehicle of historical knowledge is readable narrative, not desiccated archive — dialogue, scene, motive and suspense are lawful organs of the history: the opening tragedy of Croesus, the scene of Xerxes weeping at night, the debate speeches of Artemisia; yet every narrative device carries evidential freight (a person's speech carries their political position, a scene carries structural causation) — the literary and the evidential in one body
modes.source_chapter: 《历史》的开篇设计：以克罗伊索斯的兴亡作序——用一人悲剧引出'幸福须盖棺论定'的全书主题；人物对话皆为政治立场载体
modes.key_quote_zh: 叙事不是档案的装饰，而是档案的运费——每个场景都在搬运证据；让结构因果长出人物的血肉。
modes.key_quote_en: Narrative is not the ornament of the archive but its freight — every scene carries evidence; let structural causation grow the flesh of character.
key_concepts: 场景载因果 scene carries causation（温泉关的地形描写即是战术分析——叙事单元与论证单元合一）
scene carries causation (the description of the pass at Thermopylae is the tactical analysis — narrative unit and argument unit one)
对话载立场 speech carries position（人物发言为其政治立场的证据——修辞内容与历史内容同体）
speech carries position (a person's words as evidence of their political standing — rhetoric and history in one body)
以小见大 the small opens the large（从一人兴亡进入全书主题——克罗伊索斯是'幸福论'的序章也是权力结构的切片）
the small opens the large (one man's rise and fall opens the theme of the whole — Croesus prologue to the doctrine of happiness and section of the anatomy of power)
可读性即传播力 readability as reach（史书无人读则史亡——叙事魅力本身是历史知识存续的生态条件）
readability as reach (unread, history dies — the charm of the tale is the ecological condition of knowledge's survival)
process_zh: 定叙事骨架：先画因果网与结构对比，再决定叙事顺序——骨架在先，血肉在后
配证据器官：为每个场景/对话指定其承载的证据——无证据功能的文学装饰删除
设计入口：用一个具体人物或场景打开宏大主题——读者的第一脚踩在故事上
校验负载：成稿后逐段检查'这段在搬运什么证据'——叙事每一段都须有证据运量
process_en: Draw the skeleton first: the causal web and structural contrast before the order of telling — skeleton first, flesh after
Fit the organs of evidence: assign each scene and speech the evidence it carries — literary ornament without evidential freight is cut
Design the entrance: open the vast theme through one concrete person or scene — the reader's first step lands on a story
Audit the freight: after drafting, ask of every passage 'what evidence does this carry' — every stretch of narrative must move cargo
representative_cases_zh: 克罗伊索斯开篇（卷一）：索伦与克罗伊索斯的幸福对话——一段对话同时完成人物塑造、波斯宫廷背景与全书主题'幸福须盖棺论定'三重证据负载
薛西斯检阅大军后夜哭（卷七）：场景描写同时呈现权力顶点的孤独与帝国扩张的心理结构——一个场景搬运三层因果
阿尔泰米西娅战前谏言（卷八）：一段女性统帅的发言同时是军事分析、波斯决策结构记录与性别史材料——对话的三重档案性
representative_cases_en: The opening on Croesus (Book I): the dialogue with Solon on happiness carrying at once character, the Persian court's world, and the theme that none is happy before the end — one speech, three cargoes
Xerxes weeping after reviewing his host (Book VII): the scene showing at once the loneliness of power's summit and the psychology of imperial expansion — one scene, three layers of cause

Artemisia's war council speech (Book VIII): a woman commander's words at once military analysis, a record of Persian decision structure, and material for the history of gender — dialogue as triple archive
modern_applications_zh: 年度报告写作：用一条客户故事线承载全年战略因果——每个场景段标注其数据支撑，无支撑的修辞删除
内部技术布道：以一次真实故障的'叙事复盘'承载架构演进逻辑——对话用真实邮件原文，立场即证据
教学案例开发：用一人决策困境打开整个知识模块——每个叙事段落配'本段在教什么'的证据标签
modern_applications_en: The annual report: one customer storyline carrying the year's strategic causation — every scene tagged with its data support, unsupported rhetoric cut
Internal tech advocacy: a true incident narrated as post-mortem carrying the logic of the architecture's evolution — dialogue quoted from real mail, position as evidence
Case teaching: one person's decision dilemma opens the module — every narrative paragraph tagged with what it teaches

modes.domain_zh: 认识论方法论/对无法核实却广泛流传的材料不删除也不背书，而是原文保真并显性标注存疑——'奇闻'（thaumata）是知识的合法部分：金字塔的数字可以测量，而祭司的神话照录为祭司的神话；认识论上拒绝两个极端（全盘采信/全盘清洗），保持档案的完整光谱
modes.domain_en: Epistemological methodology / material that cannot be verified yet is widely told is neither deleted nor endorsed, but preserved verbatim with the doubt declared — the wonders (thaumata) are a lawful part of knowledge: the pyramid's measures can be taken, and the priests' myth recorded as the priests' myth; epistemically refusing both extremes ( wholesale belief / wholesale purge), keeping the full spectrum of the archive
modes.definition_zh: 认识论方法论/对无法核实却广泛流传的材料不删除也不背书，而是原文保真并显性标注存疑——'奇闻'（thaumata）是知识的合法部分：金字塔的数字可以测量，而祭司的神话照录为祭司的神话；认识论上拒绝两个极端（全盘采信/全盘清洗），保持档案的完整光谱
modes.definition_en: Epistemological methodology / material that cannot be verified yet is widely told is neither deleted nor endorsed, but preserved verbatim with the doubt declared — the wonders (thaumata) are a lawful part of knowledge: the pyramid's measures can be taken, and the priests' myth recorded as the priests' myth; epistemically refusing both extremes ( wholesale belief / wholesale purge), keeping the full spectrum of the archive
modes.source_chapter: 《历史》处理怪异材料的标准句式：'就我而言，我既不完全相信也不完全否认'——太阳逆行、神谕应验、预言成真照录并存疑
modes.key_quote_zh: 我既不完全相信，也不完全否认——把奇闻原样保真、把怀疑公开标注；档案的完整性高于叙述的整洁。
modes.key_quote_en: I neither wholly believe nor wholly deny — keep the wonder whole, mark the doubt in the open; the completeness of the archive outranks the tidiness of the tale.
key_concepts: 光谱保全 spectrum preservation（档案从'亲证'到'荒诞'连续覆盖——清洗一端即丢失该端的证据价值）
spectrum preservation (the archive covering from verified to absurd — purge one end and you lose its evidential value)
显性存疑 the open doubt（不删不改不加信用——用固定句式标注置信区间，让后来者知道边界）
the open doubt (not deleted, not altered, not credited — a fixed formula marking the confidence interval, later readers shown the boundary)
怪异即数据 the wonder as data（一个文明相信什么，与其实际发生什么同样重要——奇闻是观念史的第一手材料）
the wonder as data (what a people believed as important as what happened — the marvellous the first-hand material of the history of ideas)
反洁癖 anti-tidiness（叙事的整洁不是档案的目标——宁可保留不协调的原始声音）
anti-tidiness (the tale's neatness not the archive's goal — better to keep the discordant original voices)
process_zh: 分类入库：把材料分为可测/可信/存疑/荒诞四档——荒诞档不删除
原文保真：存疑与荒诞材料照录原始版本——不润色不改写不摘要
标注置信：用统一句式显性标注——'我既不完全相信也不完全否认'
双重用途：荒诞材料标注其观念史价值——'这个时代的人相信什么'与'发生了什么'分开立卷
process_en: File in four grades: measurable, credible, doubtful, absurd — the absurd not deleted
Preserve verbatim: doubtful and absurd material recorded in its original form — unpolished, unrewritten, unsummarised
Mark the credit: one fixed formula, openly applied — 'I neither wholly believe nor wholly deny'
Mark the double use: the absurd tagged for its history-of-ideas value — 'what this age believed' filed apart from 'what happened'
representative_cases_zh: 太阳三次逆行的记录：埃及祭司所述照录并附'我记录但我存疑'——荒诞材料的标本式处理
神谕应验的记载：既录神谕原文又录应验叙述，同时指出神谕的双解可能——不裁决真伪而保留完整案例
对'太阳神的车辙'与巨人骸骨的传闻：照录民间说法并标注无实证——观念史材料的自觉保存
representative_cases_en: The record of the sun thrice reversing course: the priests' account given whole with 'I record but doubt' — the specimen treatment of the absurd
The oracles' fulfilment: the oracle's words and the tale of fulfilment both kept, with the double reading of the oracle pointed out — verdict refused, case kept whole
The tales of the sun's chariot-track and of giants' bones: folk versions recorded with no-physical-proof noted — conscious preservation of material for the history of ideas
modern_applications_zh: 客户访谈中'据说竞品要被收购'的传闻：照录原话+注明来源层级，既不进结论也不丢弃——传闻是信号不是噪声
历史 bug 归档：无法复现的诡异现象完整保留日志与描述并标'未复现'——不做表面解释就关闭
知识库条目：民俗经验（'下雨前关节痛'）照录并标注证据等级——存疑但可检索
modern_applications_en: The corridor rumour 'the rival is being acquired': quoted verbatim, source tier noted — entering no conclusion, yet not discarded; rumour is signal, not noise
Archiving a historical bug: the unreproducible oddity kept whole with logs and description, marked 'not reproduced' — closed with no cosmetic explanation
A knowledge-base entry: folk experience ('joints ache before rain') recorded with its evidence grade — doubtful yet searchable
